title: transcript.json
description: One source's transcript: segments with timestamps, the clean-up state, review items.

video_id.description: The source id. The name is a legacy of the YouTube tool: the key stays `video_id` in every stored file, because renaming it would change stored bytes and force a model rebuild.

schema.description: Schema id and version, `<tool>.transcript/<n>`; the tool that writes the file names it and checks it.

caption.description: Provenance of the text: where the segments came from.

fetcher.description: Which fetcher or device produced the text.

speaker_source.description: How speaker fields were filled: '' | inferred | diarized.

items.description: One timed unit of text with its clean-up state.

idx.description: Position in the transcript, 0-based; equals the list index.

t1.description: End in seconds; never before t0.

speaker.description: Display name or role label for the speaker; '' when unknown.

text.description: The cue text after the passes that have run.

protected.description: Spans protected-vocabulary clean-up marked; later clean-up leaves them alone.

items.description: A protected span as it appears in text.

raw.description: The text as normalized from captions, kept once a pass changed it.

words.description: Word-level timings; empty until an audio pass exists.

items.description: A consequential reading the clean-up model was unsure of.

key.description: Stable review key, amb-NNNN, unique within the video.

span.description: The words as heard, before the pick was applied.

pick.description: The reading applied in the segment text.

confidence.description: The model's confidence in its pick, 0-1: the pick's probability when probabilities are present.

resolution.description: The author's verdict text when resolved or auto-resolved.

origin.description: For auto_resolved: the video id and date of the verdict reused.

probabilities.description: One probability per candidate, in the same order: the chance that candidate is what the speaker said. Sums to 1.

arbiter.description: Jev's pick when the arbiter applied it (ytlm.arbiter).

p_combined.description: The picked option's probability after combining with the clean-up model's.

overrode.description: Jev's option differed from the clean-up model's pick.

passes.description: Per-step provenance: what ran, what it changed, the prompt and model for model clean-up.
